scope: Google Play Console, all countries unless noted. UI windows retained as shown; no Ads settings changed.

acquisition.source: Grow users overview, Metrics by Device

listing.caution: Install clicks are not completed installs. Last-28-day listing row and 90-day overview conversion rates are different scopes.

ratings.note: The one-rating breakdown is for an older build and is not evidence about version 1.0.14.

retention.note: Very small observed count; sparse data limits interpretation.
